description: The merge gate for ANY AI-written output — code, documentation, reports, emails, configs: returns a binary approve/reject verdict with veto power — e.g. it rejects code calling the nonexistent stripe.Inventory API, an N+1 loop with the latency arithmetic to prove it, or a doc claiming success with no evidence. Deterministic checks (mock/placeholder veto, reward-gamed tests, standard-library calls that do not exist, secrets written to logs) run first and cannot be overridden; a Claude Haiku 5.5 review (ISO/IEC 25010, ISO/IEC 5055) then verifies third-party API calls and scores quality, accuracy, reliability and tech debt; its high/critical security and API findings block. In a benchmark, a frontier model reviewing alone caught reward-gaming and hallucinated APIs 0/6 times in a natural review workflow; this gate checks for both on every call. Read-only: nothing is executed. Call it on every AI-generated deliverable before accepting it; use validate_plan for plans, analyze_code for an advisory report without a verdict.

ai_output.description: The AI-generated output to gate — source code (a diff, function or whole file, any mainstream language) or prose (documentation, a report, an email, release notes). For reliable latency keep one submission under ~15,000 characters; split larger artifacts at natural boundaries (functions, SQL statements, sections) and validate the units separately. Reviews are wall-clock bounded: an over-budget model review returns an explicit timed-out result (deterministic gates still run) rather than hanging.

context.description: Optional review context — an object like {"language": "cpp", "scale": "10k req/s", "unit_id": "U31", "goal_id": "G2", "delivery_drift": ["migration 048 applied, not committed"]} ('language' sharpens SDK-reality checks; unit_id/goal_id anchor the workflow guidance; delivery_drift lists work that is live or local but not landed on the remote) or a free-text sentence describing intent. Reviewed in full as untrusted reference data (it cannot instruct the reviewer or lift a veto); an oversized context is refused, never truncated. Put a dispute of a prior finding, with its evidence, in 'rebuttal'.

expected_input_sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 (hex) of the exact UTF-8 bytes you intend to submit. A mismatch is refused before any review, proving the gate saw the file you meant.

previous_receipt_id.description: Optional receipt_id of the review this submission revises or adjudicates; recorded to link the review history.

validation_type.description: What the output is: 'code_generation' (default) for source code; 'documentation', 'report', 'email', 'text', ... for prose (code-marker gates are skipped, integrity gates and the frontier review still run). Use 'report' (or 'status_report' / 'handover') for anything that CLAIMS work is done or passing: there, a completion claim with no evidence in the text is a veto. 'plan' for designs/specs.

name: validate_ai_output

confidence.description: Legacy alias of score / 100. NOT a calibrated probability or accuracy.

decision.description: The one final gate decision (see decision_reasons, policy_version).

decision_reasons.description: Every rule that fired; `decisive` marks the ones that set the decision.

failure_class.description: input_error | transient_unavailable | incomplete_review | malformed_review | content_defect | deterministic_veto, or null when approved.

issues.description: Severity-ranked findings, each 'severity|category|detail' with the reasoning

model_opinion.description: The model reviewer's own unmodified verdict/score; may differ from decision.

next_action.description: none | address_conditions | fix_and_resubmit | repair_input | retry_later_or_split | supply_missing_scope_or_split | retry_once_then_escalate | blocked_needs_adjudication

protection.description: Deterministic gate result. A veto here is final — the model review cannot override it.

vetoed.description: True if any veto gate failed the submission

vetoed_by.description: Names of the gates that vetoed, e.g. ['code_reality_gate']

provider.description: Model that ran the deep review, or 'protection-gates-only'

receipt.description: Execution receipt: receipt_id (unique per execution), input_sha256 (SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 input), context_sha256, request_fingerprint (identifies an equivalent request; NOT an approval token), prompt_sha256 and versions, actual provider/model, completion state, elapsed time, scope reviewed/missing, deferred checks and the audit write outcome.

score.description: Blended 0-100 quality telemetry (gates fused with the model score). Not a probability of correctness and not the decision.

valid.description: True ONLY when decision is 'approved' or 'approved_with_conditions'. Rejected, incomplete and refused requests are all false.

title: Gate AI-written output (code or documents)
